actionableBoundedMap.quote: Use the existing ownership boundaries: Home owns shared runtime, packages, permissions and Mesh; Spaces owns conversations and sidebar/tab presentation; Dulche/Den retains its runtime and persistent AI-state responsibilities; Files owns canonical file identity and storage operations; Cards owns flashcard semantics; Planner owns planning entities. Existing shared CUI, Productivity Engine, Node Graph, preview/editor and integration services MUST be reused. Do not create parallel stores, permission brokers, installers or reduced embedded app implementations.

actionableBoundedMap.quote: The single trusted installer MUST install Home, all mandatory modules, the selected app and its app-required dependencies. Selecting a second app MUST reuse compatible shared packages. Internal platform package formats may be used; separate user-facing standalone MSIX installers for individual apps are not the distribution model. Native Windows and 9to1-OS use this contract through their supported packaging mechanisms. Browser apps use authenticated shared web services and MUST NOT require a local Home installation.

actionableBoundedMap.quote: Manual section membership stores references. Automatic membership is an inspectable, validated Automation/Node Graph rule over authorised chat metadata/content, including topic/keyword matching and configured inactivity duration. Removing an inactive chat from a section MUST NOT archive, delete or move the source chat. Manual and rule-based contributions must resolve to one visible reference per section; changing/disabling a rule must not erase unrelated manual membership. Match updates are incremental and bounded, not repeated whole-history scans.
actionableBoundedMap.behavior: Validated automation rules use authorized chat data, bounded incremental matching and one reference per section; inactivity removal does not delete/archive/move chat.

actionableBoundedMap.quote: Storage mode is a property of the existing canonical conversation and its managed attachments/derived records, not a separate Local Chats database. Local permits storage on the current device only; Mesh permits authorised replicas across devices in the selected personal/team namespace; Cloud adds encrypted account-storage backup to that Mesh scope. All Mesh Devices never means every device in an unrelated organisation. A newly created chat defaults to Local unless the user has explicitly chosen another eligible default. Existing chats retain their known placement on upgrade; do not migrate them silently.
actionableBoundedMap.behavior: Existing canonical conversation+attachments/derived records has Local/Mesh/Cloud placement; new chat Local default unless explicit eligible default, no silent upgrade migration.
actionableBoundedMap.proposed_owner: A Spaces/Den/Home/Mesh/Files; C4 storage + C5 transport; B
actionableBoundedMap.next_action: Owner publish versioned placement policy in existing stores, inspect actual current data; no new Local Chats DB.

Remote model/tool processing is allowed only through the separately authorised privacy route, clearly disclosed; a configured cloud fallback alone is not permission. Enforce the global Privacy Ceiling, encryption and log-minimisation rules. User copy must describe verified behaviour, not promise absolute privacy or treat restrained wording as permission for accidental uploads.
